decides: 画面元素怎么排、信息怎么分层、留给文字的空间在哪——版式是给后续工序的接口

items.prompt: single-subject hero composition, figure occupying the central vertical mass with clear breathing room around, background simplified to support, one unobstructed focal path to the face
triangle group composition, three figures arranged with the central one highest and largest, overlapping shoulders creating depth, unified eyeline toward one off-frame point
items.note: 三人队的经典稳定结构

items.prompt: character turnaround grid, the same figure shown front, three-quarter and side in three equal vertical columns, identical height and ground line across all views, construction marks faintly visible
items.note: 等高等距是纪律，高低错一像素就废

items.prompt: expression grid composition, nine equal cells each holding one head-and-shoulders portrait of the same character under identical lighting, clean gutters between cells, one emotion per cell
items.note: 格子之间必须完全一致，只换表情

items.prompt: three-panel manga layout, stacked rectangular panels with generous gutters narrating one continuous beat top to bottom, border thickness uniform, one panel allowed a tighter crop for emphasis
items.note: 格子服务节奏：起承转一屏读完

items.prompt: full-bleed splash page composition, borderless image running the entire frame with maximum impact, subject staged for scale against the largest possible environment, no panel furniture
items.note: 跨页是高潮专属，别当常态

items.prompt: diptych composition, two halves or two frames sharing identical camera angle and lighting with one decisive variable changed, clean dividing line, matched tonal weight so neither half dominates
items.note: 对比成立的前提是其他变量全同

items.prompt: wide banner composition with strong horizontal thrust, subject or title mass on one side balancing layered depth on the other, clear horizon or architectural line organizing the width
items.note: 宽幅的呼吸点在竖线上

items.prompt: tall vertical composition built for scrolling, visual beats stacked top to bottom with generous gaps, all critical shapes kept clear of the side margins, ending beat as the hook
items.note: 竖屏先想停在哪，再想画什么

items.prompt: emblem end-card composition, simplified motif or character mark centered inside a shaped frame, flat colors with one metallic accent, generous margins, readable as a small icon
items.note: 收尾卡要在缩略图尺寸还认得出

items.prompt: flat-lay prop composition, several objects arranged in a grid or radial pattern on one plane, identical top-down light, even spacing, each object fully visible without overlap
items.note: 平铺的间距要能被复现

items.prompt: composition with speech balloon zones deliberately reserved as clean negative space, subject placed to one side, empty areas planned for later dialogue overlay, tail direction implied by gaze
items.note: 留白的位置就是对话的位置

items.prompt: framing foreground composition, dark architectural or foliage shapes bordering the frame with the subject seen through the opening, layered depth between foreground and subject, light gradient across the frame edge
dense infographic composition, visual organized into labeled zones with numbered callouts and leader lines, consistent margin grid, one dominant anchor image with supporting detail blocks
